text:
*The Merchants' Guild Hall looms before you, its grand doors barricaded. Harren's mercenaries watch from the windows — a dozen at least, armed and desperate. They know there's no way out now.*

*Edric stands beside you, sword drawn. Captain Brynn's guards form a line behind you. The dock workers and veterans fill the street. It's not a professional army, but it's enough.*

Edric: "Give the word. We'll break through that door."

*From inside, Harren's voice rings out — still calm, still smiling in his tone.*

Harren: "Think carefully about what you're doing! I have men in there. I have blasting powder. Storm this building and we all die together!"

choices.text: Call his bluff — he won't destroy himself with his own wealth
Storm the building — speed and fury will overwhelm them
Find another way in — there must be a back entrance
Negotiate — offer him exile in exchange for surrender
